workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad. I've checked the calendars for Priya Raman and Marcus Hale. Here are the 30-minute slots where they are both free next week (Nov 16-20):

- Mon: 9:00 AM, 9:30 AM
- Tue: 1:00 PM, 1:30 PM
- Wed: 3:00 PM, 3:30 PM
- Thu: 10:00 AM, 2:30 PM
- Fri: 11:00 AM, 11:30 AM

Please check these times against Elena Soto's and David Okafor's calendars and let me know which slot works for all four of them.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text: Hi Alison, I've checked the calendars for Elena Soto and David Okafor. The only time that works for everyone is Thursday, November 19 at 2:30 PM. Please book the 30-minute meeting for that time.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: Thanks, Brad. I've booked the meeting for Thursday at 2:30 PM. It's now in the system. Can you please send the confirmation email to all partners?

emails.body: This email confirms the 30-minute partners' meeting for next week. Please be ready to discuss the quarterly financial report and the upcoming Weller Group litigation.
